subject: Automotive & EVs
title: Mobility as a Service
description: A quick win: understand Mobility as a Service.

hook.text: Imagine one app that combines buses, bikes, scooters, trains, and ride-hails into a single monthly plan.

buildup.text: Mobility as a Service, or MaaS, bundles all transport modes into one subscription with seamless routing.

discovery.text: Helsinki's Whim app was the first to offer this—users paid a flat fee for unlimited multimodal transport.

twist.text: MaaS works best in cities with strong public transit; in car-dependent suburbs, the model struggles.

climax.text: If MaaS scales, private car ownership in cities could drop dramatically within a generation.

punchline.text: The future of transport might be a subscription, not a purchase.

quiz.question: What does Mobility as a Service (MaaS) offer users?
options: Bundled access to multiple transport modes in one plan
